candidates.name: Alcoholic Cardiomyopathy
support_spans: symptoms usually occurred 6-20 hours after alcohol ingestion
alcohol overconsumption (250g/week) for about 20 years
ECG/Holter Findings: High-degree atrioventricular block and premature ventricular contractions
ST segments elevated 4-6 mm in leads II, III and aVF, with ST depression in leads V2-V6
candidates.why: The patient's long history of excessive alcohol consumption and the presence of cardiac abnormalities such as high-degree atrioventricular block, premature ventricular contractions, and ST segment elevations/depressions are consistent with alcoholic cardiomyopathy.
